1.title: Chapter Test: Introduction
1.description: Final task of chapter 1. Checks: console.log, let, const.

practice.description:
Create three `const`:
- `name` = `"Ivan"`
- `age` = `25`
- `city` = `"Moscow"`

Output five lines:
```
Name: Ivan
Age: 25
City: Moscow
Ivan, 25, Moscow
Done
```
practice.expected:
Name: Ivan
Age: 25
City: Moscow
Ivan, 25, Moscow
Done

2.title: Chapter Test: Data Types
2.description: Final task of chapter 2. Checks: types, coercion, == vs ===.

practice.description:
Given:
```
let a = "5";
let b = 5;
let c = 3.14;
```

Output:
```
typeof a: string
typeof b: number
typeof c: number
a == b: true
a === b: false
Number(a) + b: 10
```
practice.expected:
typeof a: string
typeof b: number
typeof c: number
a == b: true
a === b: false
Number(a) + b: 10

3.title: Chapter Test: Conditionals and Loops
3.description: Final task of chapter 3. Checks: if/else, switch, for, break.

practice.description:
For numbers 1..7 output:
- day via `switch` (`1 = Mon`, `2 = Tue`, `3 = Wed`, `4 = Thu`, `5 = Fri`, `6 = Sat`, `7 = Sun`)
- format: `<n>: <day>`
- for `n` = 6 or 7 append `" (weekend)"`

```
1: Mon
2: Tue
3: Wed
4: Thu
5: Fri
6: Sat (weekend)
7: Sun (weekend)
```
practice.expected:
1: Mon
2: Tue
3: Wed
4: Thu
5: Fri
6: Sat (weekend)
7: Sun (weekend)

4.title: Chapter Test: Functions
4.description: Final task of chapter 4. Checks: functions, arrows, rest, return.

practice.description:
Create three functions:
- `square(n)` — arrow, returns `n²`
- `sumAll(...nums)` — with rest, returns sum
- `greet(name = "guest")` — with default, `"Hello, <name>!"`

Output:
```
16
10
Hello, Anna!
Hello, guest!
```

5.title: Chapter Test: Arrays and Objects
5.description: Final task of chapter 5. Checks: methods, map/filter/reduce, objects.

practice.description:
Given array `const nums = [3, 7, 2, 8, 5];`.

Output:
```
Squares: 9,49,4,64,25
Evens: 2,8
Sum: 25
```

- `squares` — via `map`
- `evens` — via `filter`
- `sum` — via `reduce`

6.title: Chapter Test: Destructuring, Spread, Errors
6.description: Final task of chapter 6. Checks: destructuring, spread, try/catch.

practice.description:
Given object:
```
const user = { name: "Anna", age: 25, city: "Moscow" };
```

1. Destructure `name` and `age`, output `Anna 25`.
2. Via spread create `{ ...user, age: 26 }`, output `age: 26`.
3. In `try/catch` try `JSON.parse("not json")`, in `catch` output `Parse error`.

```
Anna 25
age: 26
Parse error
```

7.title: Chapter Test: Set, Map, Regex
7.description: Final task of chapter 7. Checks: Set, Map, regular expressions.

practice.description:
1. Create `new Set([1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3])`, output `size`.
2. Create `new Map([["a", 1], ["b", 2]])`, output `map.get("a")`.
3. Via regex find all digits in `"a1b22c333"` and output count.

```
Unique: 3
Map a: 1
Digits: 6
```

8.title: Chapter Test: Classes and this
8.description: Final task of chapter 8. Checks: classes, constructor, methods, inheritance.

practice.description:
Class `Animal`:
- `constructor(name)` — stores `this.name`
- `speak()` — `"<name> makes a sound"`

Class `Dog extends Animal`:
- overrides `speak()` — `"<name>: woof"`

Create `new Animal("Mystery")`, `new Dog("Rex")`, call `speak()` on both.

```
Mystery makes a sound
Rex: woof
```
practice.expected:
Mystery makes a sound
Rex: woof

11.title: Chapter Test: Asynchrony
11.description: Final task of chapter 11. Checks: Promise, async/await.

practice.description:
1. Create `delay(ms)` — returns a `Promise` that resolves via `setTimeout`.
2. In `async` function `main`, `await delay(10)` and output `Done`.
3. Catch: `Promise.reject(new Error("fail"))` via `.catch`, output `Caught: fail`.

```
Done
Caught: fail
```

12.title: Chapter Test: Modules
12.description: Final task of chapter 12. Checks: import/export.

practice.description:
Simulating modules in one file (real project — separate files).

1. Declare `add(a, b)`.
2. Declare `const PI = 3.14`.
3. Output `add(2, 3)` and `PI`.

```
5
3.14
```

Just checking you understand the meaning of export — `export` syntax in one file is not required.
